response.original_title: ((FAQS Guest))- How can I add a guest to my MSC cruise?
response.overview: To add a guest to your MSC Cruise, +1-866-829-1280(US) you must contact MSC Cruises customer service or your travel agent directly, as passenger additions cannot be processed online. Call MSC Cruises directly if you booked on your own, +1-866-829-1280(US) or reach out to your travel advisor if you used an agency. Have the new passenger's full legal name, date of birth, and Captain's Circle number (if they have cruised with MSC before) ready. To add a guest to an existing MSC cruise, you must call MSC Customer Service directly at +1-866-829-1280(US) or contact your travel agent, as passenger additions cannot be processed online.
